name: pc_info
label: About this PC
description: The PC's name, user, Windows version, screen size, shared folders and which abilities the user switched on. Start here.

name: list_folder
label: List a folder
description: Lists what is in a shared folder: name, type, size and when it changed. Without a path, lists the shared folders themselves.

name: search_files
label: Search files
description: Finds files and folders by name (case-insensitive; * and ? wildcards work) inside the shared folders, optionally only those containing some text. Stops after 15 seconds or the limit.

name: read_file
label: Read a file
description: Reads a text file (code, notes, CSV, logs, JSON…). Long files come in parts: pass next_offset back as offset. For pictures, PDFs and other binary files use share_file.

name: file_info
label: File details
description: Size, type and dates of a file or folder; for a folder, how many items it holds.

name: share_file
label: Get a download link
description: Makes a private download link for a file (any type or size), valid for a few minutes. Download it to the phone with your download tool, or look at a picture with your image tool.

name: write_file
label: Write a file
description: Writes text to a file in a folder shared with changes allowed. Mode create (default) refuses to replace a file; append adds to the end; overwrite replaces the whole file.

name: make_folder
label: Make a folder
description: Creates a folder (and any missing parents) in a folder shared with changes allowed.

name: move
label: Move or rename
description: Moves or renames a file or folder. Both places must be in folders shared with changes allowed. Never replaces something already there.

name: copy
label: Copy
description: Copies a file, or a folder with everything in it, into a folder shared with changes allowed. Never replaces something already there.

name: download_to_pc
label: Download to the PC
description: Downloads a web address (http or https) into a folder shared with changes allowed, for example a file the phone uploaded somewhere, or a link the user sent. Big downloads keep going after the answer; check with file_info.

name: delete
label: Delete
description: Moves a file or folder to the Recycle Bin (it can be restored from there). Only in folders shared with changes allowed.

name: screenshot
label: Take a screenshot
description: Captures the PC screen (one monitor, one window, all monitors, or a region to zoom in) and returns a link to the picture. Look at it with your image tool. Mouse tools take x and y in this picture's pixels.

name: mouse_click
label: Click
description: Clicks at a point. x and y are pixels in the last screenshot (take one first).

name: mouse_move
label: Move the mouse
description: Moves the pointer straight to one point, for menus that open on hover. For a smooth or multi-point movement use mouse_path. x and y are pixels in the last screenshot (take one first).

name: mouse_path
label: Move along a path
description: Moves the mouse continuously through many points in one call, with no steps in between: tracing a shape, drawing, hovering along a menu, moving a slider. Without hold it starts from where the pointer is. With hold it goes to the first point, presses that button, moves through the rest and lets go. x and y are pixels in the last screenshot (take one first).

name: mouse_drag
label: Drag
description: Presses a button at one point, drags to another and lets go. For a curved drag use mouse_path with hold. x and y are pixels in the last screenshot (take one first).

name: scroll
label: Scroll
description: Scrolls the window under a point. Positive amount scrolls up (or right), negative down (or left); one unit is one wheel notch. x and y are pixels in the last screenshot (take one first).

name: type_text
label: Type text
description: Types text into whatever has focus, as if typed on the keyboard (any language, emoji too). New lines press Enter. Click the field first.

name: press_keys
label: Press keys
description: Presses a key or shortcut, held together: enter, esc, tab, ctrl+c, ctrl+shift+t, alt+tab, alt+f4, win+d, win+r, f5, up/down/left/right, pageup, home, delete, volumeup, playpause… Separate several presses with spaces: "ctrl+a ctrl+c".

name: open
label: Open an app, file or link
description: Opens something the way double-clicking would: an app (notepad, calc, chrome, ms-settings:, explorer), a file or folder path, or a web address in the default browser.

name: read_clipboard
label: Read the clipboard
description: The text currently copied on the PC.

name: write_clipboard
label: Copy to the clipboard
description: Puts text on the PC's clipboard, ready to paste.

name: run_command
label: Run a PowerShell command
description: Runs a PowerShell command on the PC as the user and returns its output. Waits up to wait_seconds; a command still running then keeps going and returns a job_id for command_status. Can change anything the user can: be careful.

name: command_status
label: Check a command
description: Output so far of a command run_command left running, and whether it finished.

name: list_windows
label: List windows
description: The open windows (what Alt+Tab shows), the one in front first: id, title, app, position, size, minimized or maximized.

name: window
label: Arrange a window
description: Brings a window to the front, minimizes, maximizes, restores, moves/resizes or closes it (close asks the app to close, like its X button, so it may ask to save).

name: read_window
label: Read a window's controls
description: Lists the visible buttons, fields, links, menu items, tabs, list items and text of a window as numbered elements, with any field's current value, using Windows UI Automation. Then use click_element or type_into by number: faster and more exact than reading a screenshot. Some apps (games, some custom-drawn apps) expose little.

name: click_element
label: Click an element
description: Clicks element n from the last read_window, in the middle.

name: type_into
label: Type into an element
description: Clicks field n from the last read_window and types text into it, replacing what is there unless append is true. Set enter to press Enter afterwards (to search or send).

name: do_actions
label: Do several steps
description: Runs up to 200 mouse and keyboard steps in one go (one approval), then optionally takes a screenshot. Each step is an object with "action": click {x,y,button?,double?} · move {x,y} · path {points,duration_ms?,hold?} (continuous movement, like mouse_path) · drag {from_x,from_y,to_x,to_y,duration_ms?,button?} · press {button?,x?,y?} · release {button?} · scroll {x,y,amount} · type {text} · keys {keys} · wait {ms} · click_element {n} · type_into {n,text,enter?} · focus_window {window_id} · open {target}. A button left pressed is let go at the end. x and y are pixels in the last screenshot.

name: system_status
label: System status
description: CPU and memory use, disks and free space, battery, uptime and the busiest apps.

name: list_processes
label: List running apps
description: Running processes sorted by memory or CPU time: id, name, memory, CPU seconds and window title.

name: kill_process
label: Force-close an app
description: Ends a process at once by id or name (unsaved work in it is lost). To close politely, use window with action close.

name: media_control
label: Volume and media
description: Turns the volume up or down, mutes, or controls whatever is playing (play/pause, next, previous).

name: lock_pc
label: Lock the PC
description: Locks Windows (like Win+L). Nothing closes; unlocking needs the user's PIN or password at the PC.

name: power
label: Sleep, restart or shut down
description: Puts the PC to sleep, or restarts, shuts down or signs out after 30 seconds (cancel with action cancel). The companion stops answering until the PC is back.
